reviewNotes: Imported from CCEH tune 000905 (the melody read from 000905a.mid, checked against the page's do-re-mi incipit, 1 note off in 20); check the notes and the bar lines against a hymn book you trust, then set "reviewed": true. CCEH's page spells George William Martin as “George Walter Martin”; the name is printed as the sources spell it. George William Martin's dates (1825–1881) are from https://hymnary.org/tune/leominster_martin (LEOMINSTER, by George William Martin, 1825-1881, first published in The Journal of Part Music, 1862; hymnals there print his birth as 1821, 1825 or 1828, his death always 1881; 'George Walter Martin' appears nowhere, so CCEH miswrites his middle name); https://id.loc.gov/authorities/names/nr99026485 (Martin, G. W. (George William), 1825-1881, citing New Grove: b. Mar. 8, 1825, London; d. Apr. 16, 1881, London); https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/George_William_Martin (8 March 1828 - 16 April 1881); CCEH's page gives only the year 1862. Arthur Seymour Sullivan's dates (1842–1900) are from our page for the tune ST. EDMUND (SULLIVAN) (content/hymns/tunes/st-edmund-sullivan.json); CCEH's page gives none. The bar lines are those of CCEH's Noteworthy score (000905a.nwc).
